answers.core: I don't think it could work as an add-on and the `EditorPlayBar` functions backing the `EditorInterface` API already have this functionality.
answers.workaround:
This can be worked around by having the plugin write to the `editor/run/main_run_args` project setting at least for `play_main_scene`, but it doesn't work for `play_custom_scene` or `play_current_scene`

This method is also inconvenient because the setting gets saved to `project.godot` which is typically a version controlled file so you have to be careful not to accidentally commit it during testing.

Another workaround is to run `OS.create_instance` which allows for passing runtime arguments, but the problem with this method is the process that starts up isn't configured with the editor so you lose editor integration.

title: Ability to pass runtime arguments to EditorInterface play scene functions
